detail.title: Provisional Analysis: CRASH Agent Architecture and Industrial Generalizability
detail.summary: Adapting the CRASH agent framework to diverse industrial domains requires robust failure attribution. By applying causal inference methods to incident reports, agents can map failures back to decisive error steps, improving safety analysis across heterogeneous data environments.
detail.reason: Leveraging causal inference to adapt CRASH agents for industrial safety analysis.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps in Open-Ended Learning
detail.summary: Synthesis of curiosity-driven learning (CDL) signals with goal-based autonomous architectures reveals that intrinsic motivation provides the arousal mechanism necessary for identifying novel research frontiers. Agents utilizing these mechanisms transition from instruction-following to self-directed inquiry.
detail.reason: Incorporating comprehensive CDL survey data to formalize the curiosity signals used for research gap identification.

detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation and Investigation
detail.question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned, recognize its significance, and sustain an investigation toward resolving it?
detail.reason: Prior literature synthesis identified computational complexity and analytical curiosity as key variables; validation in a simulated environment is now required to bridge theoretical modeling with empirical testing.

detail.title: Autonomous Safety Analysis in Complex Systems
detail.question: How can cognitive reasoning agents designed for incident reporting, such as CRASH, be adapted to automate safety incident analysis across diverse, non-standardized industrial domains?
detail.reason: The DeFA framework (source-b3c73db2a88d4644) provides a scalable graph-based approach essential for non-standardized industrial data.

children.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and AI Identity

detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and AI Identity
detail.summary: State continuity across autonomous agent trajectories is critical to preventing high-stakes decision-making errors. Evidence suggests that without verifiable state (including hypotheses and evidence pointers), agents cannot effectively navigate complex risk scenarios.
detail.reason: Updating continuity requirements based on new risk analysis evidence.

children.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation via Hybrid Architectures and Goal Generation

detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation via Hybrid Architectures and Goal Generation
detail.summary: Autonomous discovery systems require self-healing mechanisms and meta-strategies to navigate iterative research. While computational complexity (cascading dependencies) serves as a baseline for measuring project difficulty, evaluating true scientific significance requires incorporating metrics that model the development of analytical thinking and curiosity, as seen in physics education.
detail.reason: Integrating findings from physics outreach literature (source-52719ea4691d44b7) suggests that scientific significance is not merely about complexity, but about the inquiring mindset.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps
detail.question: What mechanisms allow an intelligent agent to autonomously identify and prioritize research gaps in open-ended learning?
detail.reason: Building on recent integration of goal-based learning models to address the transition from instruction-following to autonomous research.

children.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery

detail.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery
detail.summary: Autonomous open-ended discovery benefits from integrating intrinsic curiosity mechanisms—which bootstrap learning in deceptive or unrewarding environments—with long-running multi-agent frameworks that enable persistent memory, tool interaction, and collaborative search.
detail.reason: Updating notebook nb-autonomous-inquiry-001 to incorporate newly retrieved foundational evidence on curiosity-driven learning progress alongside empirical multi-agent discovery architectures.
